expression: Author-provided X; no renormalization; ignore counts, uns and DE rankings
cell_line: K562 by Norman GSE133344 provenance; the processed file has a contradictory constant A549 obs label, which is not used
batch: No batch or replicate identifiers in obs; single pooled unknown technical stratum, never an independent replicate
canonical_condition: Sorted non-control gene symbols; pool all source aliases of the same unordered target set
output_genes: In original var order, exact symbol intersection with public whole-human scGPT vocabulary; discard interventions with any missing target

split.algorithm: Hash-rank single interventions; allocate 15% each to validation and test (round to nearest integer); hash-rank combinations separately within count of constituent singles assigned to train and apply the same allocation within stratum. Group all cells by canonical intervention. No response-dependent splitting.

control.eval_rule: Use one hash-ranked subset of up to 32 control cell IDs without replacement for every evaluated condition in the only recorded stratum; compute mean of per-cell treated predictions
control.train_rule: Each train treated cell is assigned one control from the full matched stratum by seeded hashing with replacement; assignment stays fixed for D0 and changes with epoch for D1; held-out treated cells are never inputs
control.inference_only: The test outcome is stored separately and is scored only with a frozen confirmation plan

metrics.primary: Mean over conditions of RMSE across all shared genes of (prediction minus provided control mean) vs (truth minus same control mean)
secondary: Direction agreement on top 20 nonzero measured absolute deltas
Recall of the top 20 measured absolute delta genes among equally many predicted absolute delta genes
metrics.definitions: Zero variance Pearson is undefined and omitted with a count; absent predictions are rejected unless additive coverage is explicitly allowed. Top ranks are evaluation-only, with original gene order breaking ties.

linear.features: Mean of the L2-normalized one-hot exact target and L2-normalized outgoing GO neighbor vector for each intervention target, concatenated at equal weight; retain GO edge weights from public author go.csv for shared genes
linear.selection: Choose by validation condition-macro delta RMSE, break ties by smaller alpha
linear.fit: Kernel ridge on train intervention mean responses, centering the response using only train interventions
